snippet.title: FEAR FACTORY - Roboticist (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
snippet.description:
Industrial metal pioneers @fearfactorymusic launches a bold new era with "Roboticist," — the latest single marks the recording debut of the band's current lineup featuring vocalist Milo Silvestro, drummer Pete Webber, and bassist Tony Campos. Blending crushing mechanical aggression with a haunting, melodic hook, the track explores a dystopian reality where flesh fails and only consciousness endures.

"The future isn’t coming. It’s already here, ‘Roboticist’ is the next evolution of Fear Factory.
Man, Machine and the war for what comes next. I can’t wait for everyone to hear the beginning of a new era of Fear Factory."
Dino Cazares

Produced, engineered, mixed, and mastered by Damien Rainaud, the single arrives alongside a cinematic music video directed by Vincente Cordero and produced by Arion Csihar. System activated: the next chapter of FEAR FACTORY has officially begun.

Death is no longer the end—it is the next evolution. The machine no longer needs humanity; it inherits the future.

apple pay and i'm tapping in
if they pull out go after them
time to pull up we back again 

Deck

INS logo on the flamethrower 
i light em up back to back like a chainsmoker
get placed in a coma facing the soldier 
hundred shots fired you barely grazed my shoulder 
i keep my heat by the freezer
on a planet full of apes i'm caesar 
charlie horse talk spicey like tandoori
we ain't on the same page they a sad story 
mad corny i don't even know your backstory 
back up off me let me live i'll be back shortly 
liquid on the flow call it H20 
in the kitchen at the stove making plates to go 
grind over time whether rain or snow
so i'm stacked with the good like Trader Joe 

Eso

mad technology pouring out of my bodily
audibly causing chaos i play em all off methodically 
sonically not robotically it's human made, you afraid
when i die don't say "this one stings" throw me a huge parade

represent the dead bent like operation dumile

every hero needs a villain live from the kumite 
dangerous, nightcrawler bamf! where the students play

jewelry yeah you got a extravagant taste 
what a waste like katy perry in space
i illustrate while you trace
kill a tape while you chase clout
i seal your fate with a fist 
no you laid out, played out 
no hard feelings i don't suffer from ED
you're lyrics a little limp mine hit like a DDT 

Frankie

oh yes we on that life
catch me coming down the mountain with a combat knife
so precise that, you could get your contacts sliced

you shit-for-brain no name lame, that bites like cujo
i'd rather masturbate to kathy bates than hear you flow
and you know, that misery it, loves company 
pin 'em to the mat like 1,2,3 i emerge triumphantly
he should be least of your
concerns when i speak with raw
beatin P is, not an easy chore like defeating thor
your frees, they produce enough cheese to feed the poor
my frees, so cold they locked behind a freezer door
frankie, my myself and i is who i'm speaking for 
sprinkle dope across the verse, shout to shamiek moore 
catch me out in the ybor, city with a sweet whore
try to photograph me and naaah i take a detour

“BREAK FREE” is a powerful spiritual soulful Tech House journey about breaking away from fear, expectations and the limits we place on ourselves.

Sometimes you follow a path because someone else told you it was the right one.
Sometimes you hide your fire underneath the noise.
Sometimes you wait for permission to become the person you were always meant to be.

But freedom can begin with one simple decision.

To stop waiting.
To stop hiding.
To stop living according to someone else's voice.

Your heart already knows the way.

Listen closely.

Break free.

#AvengersDoomsday #Avengers #Marvel 

AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY
The end of an era begins.

MovieTrailers Entertainment presents the "Sacrifice" Final Trailer Concept for Marvel Studios' AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY, the next major event in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

A new threat is rising. The Avengers are assembling once again. And at the center of it all stands Doctor Doom.

snippet.title: ThunderCats: Pumm-Ra (1985) | Cinematic 4K AI Short Film
snippet.description:
#ThunderCatsTeaserTrailer #ThunderCatsTrailer #ThunderCatsLiveActionTrailer #thunderCats #80scartoons 

Experience the epic battle for Third Earth like never before in this cinematic retro live-action reimagining of the 1985 ThunderCats (80s cartoons version). Watch Lion-O and Cheetara and Panthro and the team face off against Mumm-Ra’s forces in this high-quality AI concept short film.

In this fan-made concept film, we bring the iconic 80s heroes to life using advanced AI cinematic tools. Inspired by the classic 1985 episode 'Pumm-Ra,' this AI-enhanced cinematic short brings the deception of Mumm-Ra to life like never before. We wanted to capture the tension of having a traitor in the midst of the ThunderCats.

This is my parody on the beloved series: ThunderCats New Movie Teaser Trailer Live Action AI Fan-Made Concept where I portray through ""A.I."" what it could look like.  This is based on the 1985 TV cartoon series.

0:00 The Infiltration Begins
2:59 The Feast at Cat's Lair
5:12 Searching for the Sword of Omens
11:06 Mumm-Ra’s True Form Revealed

How we built this (without losing our minds): Bringing the 1985 ThunderCats into the 4K era takes more than just a magic sword. Our "technical" process involved a chaotic mix of high-end AI and a suspicious amount of caffeine. We leaned on Claude to help us refine the story and craft image and video prompts, then used Nano-Banana and GPT-Image 2 and Seedance 2.5 to generate the hyper-realistic visuals and videos you see here.  Thankfully that didn't result in Panthro having three arms. It’s a wild time to be a creator when your "camera crew" is a series of complex algorithms and a digital banana!

Which classic ThunderCats episode or characters should we bring to life in 4K next? Let us know in the comments!

I hope you enjoy and if you like it please like, comment and subscribe for many more videos like this.

New trailer concept for CRYSTAL LAKE, the upcoming A24 Peacock horror series prequel to the Friday the 13th horror movie franchise. This Crystal Lake trailer mixes clips of Pamela and Jason Voorhees from the official Crystal Lake series trailer and Friday the 13th horror shorts. Crystal Lake Series Trailer Breakdown:

0:00 Camp Crystal Lake Opens Again 
0:19 Jason Voorhees Drowns
0:30 Friday the 13th Birthday
0:40 Town is Cursed
0:58 Kill Them Mommy
1:12 Mommy's Here
1:34 Crystal Lake 2026 Trailer Recap

──────────────────

"The legend begins... with Pam."

A new Crystal Lake trailer has dropped to remind you that the original Friday the 13th killer wasn't Jason Voorhees. It was his mother, Pamela Voorhees. 

A24's highly anticipated Crystal Lake TV show is making a major stop at New York Comic Con before its official debut on Peacock and HBO Max. The studio has confirmed that the Crystal Lake premiere episode will receive an exclusive first-look screening at the Empire Stage at the Javits Center in New York City.

Following the screening, attendees will be treated to a panel discussion featuring series creator Brad Caleb Kane (IT Welcome to Derry) and several members of the cast, including Linda Cardellini (Pamela), William Catlett, Devin Kessler, Cameron Scoggins (Officer Dorf), Gwendolyn Sundstrom (Claudette), and Callum Vinson (Jason). 

This early screening offers a unique opportunity for fans to see how the production expands the mythology of the Friday the 13th franchise. By showcasing the episode at a major event like New York Comic Con, the creative team is signaling confidence in the Crystal Lake series as it prepares for its wider streaming release.

Serving as a Friday the 13th prequel series to the 1980 horror movie classic, Crystal Lake trailer focuses on the life of Pamela Voorhees before she became the iconic killer. Linda Cardellini stars as Pamela, portraying a single mother struggling with grief nearly a year after the tragic drowning of her young son, Jason Voorhees. The narrative kicks off when two strangers arrive at her home to investigate her past, triggering a disturbing chain of events.

While the premise leans into psychological drama and conspiracy thriller elements, creator Kane has assured fans that the horror series will eventually embrace the bloody horror associated with the iconic horror movie franchise. He has teased that the series will feature numerous connections to the original films, including various Viernes 13 Easter eggs and recreations of familiar elements that long-time Friday the 13th fans will recognize.

The Camp Crystal Lake horror series has seen significant changes since it was first ordered by Peacock in 2022. While Bryan Fuller was initially attached as the writer and show runner, he departed the A24 project in 2024, leading to Kane taking over creative duties. Despite these behind-the-scenes shifts, the crystal lake show has already secured distribution with HBO Max for Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the UK, and Ireland.

All eight episodes of Crystal Lake premiere on Peacock October 15, 2026 and internationally on HBO Max by year's end.

X ► https://twitter.com/ClashRoyale/
Instagram ► https://www.instagram.com/clashroyale
TikTok ► https://www.tiktok.com/@clashroyale
Facebook ► https://www.facebook.com/ClashRoyale/

ENTER THE ARENA
Build your Battle Deck and outsmart the enemy in fast real-time battles. From the creators of CLASH OF CLANS comes a real-time multiplayer battle game starring your favourite Clash characters and more. Start battling against players from around the world!

BECOME A MASTER OF STRATEGY AND DECK BUILDING
Choose unique Cards to your Battle Deck and head to the Arena for Battle!
Place your Cards right and knock down the enemy King and Tower Troops from their Towers in a strategic and fast-paced match.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE 100+ CARDS
Hog Rider! Collect and upgrade 100+ Cards featuring the Clash of Clans troops, spells and defences you know and love and many others. Win battles and progress to new Arenas to unlock powerful new Cards to your collection!

BATTLE YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Battle your way to the League and Global Tournaments to match against the best players in the world.
Compete for glory and rewards!

SEASONAL EVENTS
Unlock new Seasonal items like Tower Skins, Emotes and powerful Magic Items with the Season Pass and participate in fun Challenges that put your skills to the test!

JOIN A CLAN AND GO TO WAR
Join or form a Clan with other players to share Cards and battle in Clan Wars for BIG rewards!

See you in the Arena!
#ClashRoyale

snippet.title: Surviving Minecraft's Best Horror Mod
snippet.description:
Today I'm diving deep into The Broken Script, one of the strangest and most unsettling Minecraft horror mods I've ever played. What starts as a normal Minecraft survival world slowly turns into a corrupted Minecraft ARG filled with creepy entities, random events, impossible structures, hidden dimensions, glitches, world corruption, and things that feel like they absolutely should not be happening in Minecraft.

I played a ridiculous amount of The Broken Script to see just how far this mod goes. Unlike most Minecraft horror mods, The Broken Script is extremely unpredictable. Strange entities can appear in the distance, structures can suddenly generate around you, the world can change without warning, and the game itself can begin behaving like something is wrong with it.

If you like Minecraft horror, scary Minecraft mods, Minecraft ARGs,  cursed Minecraft, survival horror, mysterious entities, analog horror, liminal Minecraft, or heavily modded Minecraft, this is one of the wildest mods I've played.

Character dies, it's gone
GAME OVER = full reset
ONLY ONE NEW CHARACTER PER ZONE, THE FIRST ENCOUNTER. If you run from it you lose it. (marked on map, 15 total)
WHEN ENTERING NEW AREA, MUST WIN FIRST FIGHT before you're allowed to run (to make rolling characters bearable) the exception to this is the flipside, which you can run in IMMEDIATELY
All chips and bytes allowed (including auto gift)
NO giftbox MOVE (can use a character with the move, just no clicking it)
Can only roll Halloween Character after getting KEY, must be random, you can do minigame or FILES it in

snippet.title: 🔴Blox Fruits TRAILER Update 30 Count Down OUT NOW!!
snippet.description:
🔴Blox Fruits TRAILER Update 32 Count Down OUT NOW!!

Breaking down EVERYTHING from the official teaser — Magnet Fruit, First Sea / Sea 1 rework, island challenges, completion rewards, new UI, 3D weapon shop, sea raids, and whatever Gamer Robot drops today.

This is TRAILER day (August 29, 2026). 

Official teaser: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZeiCK3sNCRo
Play Blox Fruits: https://www.roblox.com/games/2753915549/Blox-Fruits

========================
EVERYTHING IN THE UPDATE 30 TEASER
========================

🧲 MAGNET FRUIT
• Brand new Magnet-type Blox Fruit
• Giant mechanical / mech transformation with jet cannons
• Bigger than Buddha form in the teaser
• Price, rarity, and full Z/X/C/V/F kit 

🌊 FIRST SEA / SEA 1 REWORK
The whole starter sea is getting rebuilt:

Islands shown or called out:
• Windmill Island — rebuilt starter island, moving windmills
• Marine Fortress — huge castle / fortress city, more cannons
• Water Seven — revamped + new island events and side quests
• Frozen Village — new look + “FROZEN VILLAGE COMPLETED” screen
• Middletown — big new building + glowing portal
• Magma Island — visual revamp
• Fountain Island — one of the biggest glow-ups
• Jungle docks — hidden “FRUIT DETECTED: 280m away” tease

🏆 ISLAND CHALLENGES + AWARDS
• Every island gets its own quests / challenges
• Star-based island completion (teaser shows a 3-star style complete screen)
• Frozen Village Completed screen = awards when you finish an island
• Crafting: turrets, weapons
• Frozen Village snowman challenge (build snowmen that run around)
• Island recommendation flowchart showing where to go next
• Rewards for clearing island challenges (levels / completion rewards)

🖥️ UI CHANGES
• Full NPC / dialogue UI revamp
• 3D Weapon Shop UI — Sword Dealer of the West
• Preview weapon models before you buy
• See skills on the item (Dual Katana, Iron Mace)
• Moves shown: Mace Smash, Killer Combo
• Purchase prompt example: $25,000
• New map / island completion UI
• Next-island recommendation UI

⚔️ COMBAT + EVENTS
• Sea raid: man fortress cannons and shoot incoming pirate ships
• Character prompt with Parius — “Man the fortress cannons”
• Gorilla King boss evolution — eats a banana and powers up
• New interactive map objects (geysers / island interactions)
• Middletown glowing portal (possible sea-to-sea travel)

🍍 OTHER FRUIT TEASES
• Magnet Fruit confirmed on screen
• Hidden unannounced fruit near Jungle (“FRUIT DETECTED: 280m away”)
• Teaser dialogue: “I accidentally ate that Smoke fruit. Somebody gave me a Quake after.”
• Venom / Dark / Quake reworks are NOT confirmed in this teaser

📅 DATES
• Official teaser: already live
• Full trailer date on screen: August 29, 2026

In this live:
• Wait / react to the official Update 30 trailer
• Slow-mo every Sea 1 island
• Magnet Fruit transformation breakdown
• Island challenges, stars, and rewards
• New shop UI + what you can actually buy
• Sea raid cannons
• Gorilla King glow-up
• Hidden fruit + Quake / Smoke line
• Confirmed vs rumor
• What to prep before the real update (Beli, inventory, trades)
• Chat Q&A
